name: Rånö
description: An easy, mostly gravel-road Rånö section with open forest, beaches, swimming coves, designated campsite services and optional forest-path variants. The guide-described hike starts by the ferry/services at Rånö Källan, heads north through Rånö Gård and the northern out-and-back, then returns via Rånöhamn, Harviken/Skutviken and Rånö Källan.
notes: Route shape: counterclockwise loop/lollipop from Rånö Källan / Rånö brygga, with a northern out-and-back and west-side/Knicksand option; do not infer trailhead/end from official GPX ordering.

facilities.name: Rånö Livs
facilities.description: Seasonal grocery/reception near the ferry quay. Current operator page gives 2026 spring opening windows and describes it as the island shop/Systembolaget agent; verify current hours before display.

facilities.name: Rånö Livs drinking water
facilities.description: Public/route-side drinking-water point by the ferry-side service cluster. SAT says water is available by the convenience shop; OSM/Wikimedia support seasonal water, but operator pages do not precisely confirm a public tap at Rånö Livs, low-season guidance says the camping hand pump may be the only Rånö service, and a 2025-08-02 field photo shows a temporary water-shortage closure sign. Keep seasonal/check-before-relying wording and do not present as dependable primary water.

facilities.name: Rånö Brygga public toilet
facilities.description: Accessible public dry toilet near Ärnviken/Rånö brygga. Keep separate from the customer-only restaurant toilets.

facilities.name: Rånö camping / Oxhagen
facilities.description: Basic nature campsite on eastern Rånö by the sound toward Ålö; management plan describes about 30 tent places at Oxhagen. Paid/booking/local terms should be checked with Rånö Brygga.

facilities.name: Rånö camping water pump
facilities.description: Drinking-water pump at/near the campsite. Rånö Brygga says drinking water is controlled and safe and that the tent site has a manual pump; Visit Skärgården and OSM also support campsite pump water.

facilities.name: Rånö camping dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilets at the campsite, mapped as access=yes/fee=no and supported by campsite sources. Keep currentness guarded: newer OSM/photo/operator evidence supports the toilet, while an unresolved August 2025 OSM note asks whether an older mapped toilet remains.

facilities.name: Rånöhamn drinking water
facilities.description: Drinking-water point associated with Rånöhamn. SAT explicitly lists water at Rånöhamn; OSM history and Wikimedia field photos show the point off in April 2025 and switched on in August 2025, supporting a normal seasonal marker with check-before-relying wording.

facilities.name: Rånöhamn toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at Rånöhamn/north Rånö nature-harbor context. Supported by reserve management-plan and OSM survey-created toilet node, but no recent photo/current official visitor-page confirmation was found; verify locally if relying on it.

facilities.name: Skutviken toilets
facilities.description: Public dry toilets at Skutviken on the west side. Länsstyrelsen explicitly lists dry toilets at Skutviken on Rånö; OSM supplies current mapped details.

facilities.name: Harviken fireplace
facilities.description: Designated fire/grill place at Harviken beach. SAT step guide names a fire pit here; Grillplatser says it was placed by SAT. Fire bans always override.

facilities.name: Knicksand barbecue areas
facilities.description: Grouped BBQ/fireplace cluster by Knicksand beach/holiday village. Treat nearby OSM/Grillplatser records as one display cluster. Fire bans always override.

facilities.name: Knicksand beach and swimming coves
facilities.description: Western-side bathing area by the holiday village: shallow beach, bathing jetty, cliffs and sunset views over Mysingen. Exact beach polygon not confirmed in iteration 1.

facilities.name: Harviken beach
facilities.description: Small sandy beach about 50 m off the route near Harviken; SAT and Rånö's own site recommend Harviken for swimming.

facilities.name: Skutviken swimming cliffs
facilities.description: Bay/nature harbor and swimming-cliff area on the western side; SAT routes a final detour down to Skutviken and its swimming cliffs.
